headline: Iraq-Germany Economic Cooperation Talks in Baghdad | Iraq Business News
summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi received Germany's development minister Reem Alabali-Radovan in Baghdad. The sides discussed expanding economic, investment and trade cooperation, including a possible development memorandum of understanding.
why: Government-level memoranda on investment and trade can open opportunities for German companies in Iraq's reconstruction and energy-related sectors.
